notes_for_editor: Thin record: three web pages, no staffing, no fire history, no site description. Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history (page dated 2025-10-02); not used in the story. Access key omitted because no source states access. The NFSL Clearwater lookout study download (nfsl.contentdm.oclc.org item 28879) returned only its introduction, and its text does not name Gospel Hill, so it is not cited. The brief's status 'gone' rests on 'probably removed', so treat as gone with a hedge on the date. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story now calls it the Gospel Hill site, since no source describes its terrain.
